newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait stock index passes 2,000 point mark.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait stock index passes 2,000 point mark.

text.p: Kuwait's share index on Monday rose 4.9 points, crossing the 2,000-point mark for the first time.
The Kuwait Stock Exchange index ended the day at 2,000.2. The post-Gulf War index was launched on November 25, 1995, at 1,380.6 points.
It rose 74.7 points in the trading week ending Wednesday to a record 1,975.1 points as strong year-end profits by listed firms fueled demand.

During the 2-1/2-hour trading day, 125.3 million shares worth 38.6 million dinars ($127.8 million) changed hands on Monday compared to last week's daily average of 81.7 million shares worth 25.1 million dinars.
